error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Synology DSM.
error.dns_error: HAOS cannot resolve the DSM hostname. Check local DNS or NAT loopback settings.
error.tls_error: HAOS could not verify the DSM HTTPS certificate. Use the hostname covered by the certificate.
error.timeout_error: The DSM connection timed out from HAOS. Check firewall, local DNS, and NAT loopback settings.
error.webapi_forbidden: DSM returned HTTP 403 for WebAPI. Point this hostname to the DSM portal, not Web Station or an application portal.
error.invalid_webapi_response: The address did not return a valid Synology WebAPI response.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid Synology DSM HTTPS URL.
error.invalid_camera_ids: Camera 1 and Camera 2 must use different IDs.
error.otp_required: This DSM account requires an OTP that CCTV Relay cannot submit. Use a dedicated Surveillance Station account without interactive OTP.
error.account_locked: The DSM account is locked or temporarily blocked.
error.password_change_required: The DSM account password has expired or must be changed before API login.
error.insufficient_permissions: The DSM account does not have the required recording or Action Rule history permissions.
error.recording_check_failed: Recording access failed for a selected Surveillance Station camera. Check recording playback permissions.
error.history_check_failed: Action Rule history could not be queried. Disable history recovery for a spectator account or use a Surveillance Station administrator.
error.missing_apis: DSM does not expose all Synology APIs required by CCTV Relay.
error.synology_api_error: Synology returned an API error. Check the Home Assistant log for the operation and code.
error.telegram_not_ready: The selected Telegram notify entity or send actions are not available.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.camera_not_found: One or more selected cameras were not found in Surveillance Station. Reload the camera list and select again.
error.not_enough_cameras: Surveillance Station must provide at least two accessible cameras.
